description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of twelve distinct topical categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend or internal percentage labels; instead, each category is identified by text labels and percentages positioned outside the pie, connected to their respective slices by thin grey callout lines. Moving clockwise from the top right, the segments include AI/NLP Research (blue, 24.3%), Business (red, 5.9%), Geography (gold, 2.7%), Math (dark green, 1.2%), Game&Anime (dark orange, 8.2%), Econ. & Fin. (teal, 18.4%), Science (light blue, 6.7%), Law (light red, 5.1%), History (yellow, 8.2%), Med & Health (light green, with its percentage visually obscured by a solid grey rectangular block), Pet & Animal (light orange, 5.5%), and Daily Life (light cyan, 7.1%). The slices do not appear to be ordered by size, such as in a descending or ascending manner, and none of the segments are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
